key_contrast_audit.decision: Closed at this site. No protection weights; approximate score effects are not classification results.

conditional_theory_review.name: cross_module_curvature_and_linear_span_conditions
conditional_theory_review.decision: Fixed public-projection edits still reach the same completed parameter state jointly. Trap2 loss bounds are conditional and do not survive this equality as a new defense guarantee. NUFILT alignment does not establish an exact 16-dimensional activation subspace. No credible new candidate.

estimated_projection_review.name: estimated_projection_and_release_spectrum_boundary
estimated_projection_review.decision: Exact local preservation exposes the native activation span from the release. For rank-k additive noise, truncating the top-k released-update right singular space bounds remaining noise by twice the original update spectral norm, independent of noise amplitude. This is an identification bound, not a successful classifier attack; shared useful output directions can make truncation costly.

minimal_coupled_preservation_review.site: block0 head0 Q/K, existing original and archived release
minimal_coupled_preservation_review.decision: Linear paired change fails complement-only parameter preservation or exposes a public kernel; not a new defense. General nonlinear MLP cancellation remains conditional.

eight_task_resources_on_3090.limitation: Only path presence checked in this read-only inspection. Prior seven-task replication records are retained; not a current-server full eight-task run or ARF reproduction.

nonlinear_preservation_review.name: QuickGELU_sign_and_actual_residual_preservation

Query_replacement_preflight.name: full_Query_support_replacement_cost_control
Query_replacement_preflight.decision: Complete public replacement preserves every native MNIST and merged MNIST/DTD prediction. Any release limited to this Query support maps to this same measured state. Close this support without noise; this does not exclude joint Q/K, other heads or other merge pools.

functional_subspace_source_review.name: ESM_v2_paper_source_and_local_error_identity
functional_subspace_source_review.decision: Input activation, local task-update output shift and classification-effective computation are distinct. Source uses raw SVD with n-1 normalization; empirical component identity and nonzero-mean decomposition verified. Fixed output projection still has a public common-state cleaner under stated noise conditions. Do not rename output-complement noise as a new mechanism; no credible defense candidate.

MINGLE_source_review.name: MINGLE_pinned_source_and_gate_preservation_review
MINGLE_source_review.decision: MINGLE requires learned gates and added low-rank experts. Its input-dependent mixture does not generally fold into one ordinary affine weight. Gradient null projection alone does not guarantee an Adam update, unprojected bias or changed upstream inputs preserve task computation. Record this scoped condition, not a new defense or a criticism of unreplicated paper accuracy.

local_global_preservation_review.name: local_vs_global_preservation_and_exact_anchor_recovery
local_global_preservation_review.kind: Conditional proof and exact-rational illustrative two-layer square network, not a CLIP candidate
local_global_preservation_review.execution: local CPU and 3090 server CPU; no CUDA
local_global_preservation_review.decision: Exact per-operator affine input preservation exposes unchanged native intermediate spans; with tau_i C_i=0 public completion returns original edited parameters, even though merges can be disturbed. Final-output or output-projected preservation is weaker and outside this proof. Approximate alignment requires actual residual utility and hybrid-model inputs; no real classifier certificate or universal impossibility.

mlp_functional_null.name: native_MLP_common_functional_direction
mlp_functional_null.site: block0 MLP c_fc output and unchanged c_proj
mlp_functional_null.decision: No exact common local null direction at this fixed site/input scalar; weakest approximate direction is concentrated on always-negative neurons. This is not a distinct finite posthoc mechanism, and no public cleanup utility cost has been established. Close this W1-only continuous direction diagnostic without protection or rank/layer scans. Full rank is not a classification or universal impossibility theorem.

nufilt_geometry_review.name: NUFILT_geometry_and_gate_fold_scope
nufilt_geometry_review.decision: Theorem requires actual representation rank, bounded training-trajectory error and a spectral gap, not only intrinsic image dimension. Complement cleanup removes tau C residual; its classification cost is not implied. Pinned row-gate forward and folded column weight differ by the antisymmetric BA term, but source matrix objective and final fold agree; do not invalidate paper metrics or change upstream code. No new defense candidate.

gradient_immunity_review.name: Gradient_Immunity_protected_release_boundary
gradient_immunity_review.decision: Protects downstream fine-tuning under assumed non-removable PPOW/hardware component. Custom backward gating is distinct from ordinary derivative of the forward identity; gradient-free AGA and public replacement do not require that gate. Published reference uses hidden output head; entanglement prototype trains head and declares no GPU validation. Do not port it or import its assumption as measured recovery cost.

paired_MLP_preservation_review.name: paired_MLP_finite_task_preservation_conditions
paired_MLP_preservation_review.kind: Own symbolic conditional analysis; not a paper theorem or a CLIP experiment
paired_MLP_preservation_review.decision: Paired first-order cancellation does not establish a finite edit. A fixed PCA preactivation complement need not remain a task complement after elementwise activation. Simultaneous fixed right-complement edits still have a common public-completion state; approximate task-only and nonzero intermediate cancellations are not universally excluded. No credible candidate; no weights or diagnosis.

downstream_task_space_review.name: downstream_classification_and_SVC_scope
downstream_task_space_review.finite_classification_condition: For nonzero CLIP features and zero head bias, centered class ordering equals Ah+s(h)b. Finite q changes it by Aq+[s(h+q)-s(h)]b; kernel(A) alone does not establish prediction preservation.
downstream_task_space_review.decision: No credible new complement-only ordinary-weight relation or measured useful cleanup cost. Existing readout code already accounts for variance/beta and is not reopened. SVC is local spectral calibration, not a task-space or arbitrary-noise cleanup guarantee; no defense or recovery result.

task_identification_subspace_review.name: task_identification_subspace_and_MASS_scope
task_identification_subspace_review.decision: Task-update singular span and input manifold are distinct from a finite ordinary-weight task-preservation space. Projection/MAP results do not supply cleanup cost; CLS routing does not certify all-token computation. No candidate, model, router, or scan.

finite_pre_activation_coupling_review.name: finite_pre_activation_complement_coupling_check
finite_pre_activation_coupling_review.kind: Own exact symbolic analysis, not an implemented defense or a CLIP experiment
finite_pre_activation_coupling_review.finite_relation: For native z=Pz and T=P+sC, paired first/downstream transform changes output by (1/s-1)W2 C phi(z). Pre-activation dimension does not certify post-activation span.
finite_pre_activation_coupling_review.decision: No admissible new candidate: nonlinear computation can use complement of pre-activation space already in the native expert. Exact paired gauge preservation requires a further hidden-output condition; no source of measured recovery cost established.
